source: Oh Zebna, oh, oh, oh Zebna. That was… Leave NOW. Grab what you can and go. If I’m lucky, I’ll run into a new group, a new tribe – somewhere. I never meant to harm her… I only went down to the trout stream this morning for water, and then I saw her rustling and humming in the upper branches of a mulberry tree collecting its fruit. I thought I could talk to her, a grown girl, perhaps 14, and share some sort of feminine empathy, woman to woman… Is it the way I called to her, the way I appeared? She saw me, lost her footing and fell. Head first. Neck cracked. She went limp… fear frozen on her face. At best I can never approach these people again. At worst, I’ll be hunted… Where to go? Where to sleep? WHEN AM I?!
target: 噢，潔布娜，噢，噢，噢，潔布娜。剛才那是…… 現在就走。能拿什麼就拿，快走。 運氣好的話，我會在某個地方遇到另一群人，另一個部落。 我從沒想過要傷害她…… 今天早上，我只是去那條有鱒魚的溪邊取水，然後看見她在桑樹高處的枝葉間窸窣移動，哼著歌採果子。我想，也許能跟她說話。她已經是個大女孩了，大概十四歲，也許能有些女性之間的同理，女人與女人之間的理解…… 是我叫她的方式，還是我出現的樣子？她看見我，腳下一滑，摔了下來。頭先著地。脖子斷了。整個身子軟了下去……恐懼凝固在她臉上。 最好的情況，是我再也不能接近這群人。最糟的情況，是他們會追殺我…… 該去哪裡？ 該睡哪裡？ 我到底身在哪個時代？！

source: Subject: URGENT - Temporal Data Processing Complete To: Moharan-TC, Kwalan-TC [Undeliverable: Zebna-TC,Yira-TC] Forgive my waking message as a digital-note sent to your lab accounts. I wiped my ambulatory and audio-speech capability three years ago for additional memory. The unimaginable is mapped. The conclusion is deeply unnerving. The data from the portal experiments proved critical. Like the poles of a tent, the portal data provided stable dimensional points around which to construct a hypothetical framework of time. I was able to extrapolate the ripple effects of the portal events within this simulated framework, and discovered the greatest ripple of all. We expected time to be circular. But I never would have hypothesized that our circle, our reality’s time flow, pinches into a critical event, like the stem of an hourglass. In year seven of processing, I found the spatial data of the incident which I call the Foci Crux – the event of the past that guarantees the existence of our present. I was unable to determine the exact date/time. In year 9 of processing, I commenced the most exhaustive theoretical calculations to define the factors of the Foci Crux. The result: Location: Asbury Pines, Pine Hills Park Event: EVERLY PRAETIS DIES Date/time: Unknown. Some point in Everly Praetis’ lifetime. To the best of my capacity, based on the recorded imagery and historical and genetic information of the Praetis lineage, I have produced this digital rendering of the Everly Praetis who is our Foci Crux: To state the implications of my findings in the clearest terms possible: the death of Everly Praetis ensures the existence of our unprecedented human achievement. Unrelated: Please let me know why Zebna and Yira have not logged notes to our Lab network for an extended time.
target: 主旨：緊急——時間數據處理完成 收件者：Moharan-TC、Kwalan-TC ［無法送達：Zebna-TC、Yira-TC］ 請原諒我甦醒後的第一則訊息，是以電子便箋寄到各位的實驗室帳號。三年前，為了騰出更多記憶體，我刪除了行走與語音功能。 難以想像之物，已繪成地圖。結論令人深感不安。 傳送門實驗的數據，證實是關鍵所在。就像帳篷的支柱，傳送門數據提供了穩定的維度座標，讓我得以圍繞它們，建立假設的時間架構。我在這套模擬架構中推算傳送門事件的漣漪效應，並發現了其中最大的一道漣漪。 我們預期時間是循環的。但我從未設想過，我們的循環、我們這個現實的時間流，竟會像沙漏的細頸，收束於一個關鍵事件。運算的第七年，我找到了這件事的空間數據，並稱之為「樞紐焦點」——一件發生於過去、確保我們的現在得以存在的事件。我無法確定其精確日期與時間。 運算的第九年，我展開極為徹底的理論計算，以確定樞紐焦點的構成因素。結果如下： 地點：阿斯伯里松林鎮，松丘公園 事件：艾芙莉・普雷蒂斯死亡 日期／時間：未知。艾芙莉・普雷蒂斯一生中的某個時刻。 我根據普雷蒂斯家族留下的影像、歷史與基因資料，盡我所能，製作了這張艾芙莉・普雷蒂斯的數位模擬肖像。她就是我們的樞紐焦點： 若要以最清楚的方式說明這項發現的含義：艾芙莉・普雷蒂斯之死，確保了我們這番人類空前成就的存在。 另有一事：請告訴我，潔布娜與伊拉為何已長時間未在實驗室網路登錄筆記。

source: Moharan Praetis: Be careful with this gem. I had Pitra-Patra laser etch Everly’s image into it so that you can recognize her readily. Added a chain too so it’s more secure. And is there… yes, good, I see you had the universal coordinates of the portal location tattooed on your forearm. You have a compass then, some freeze-dried—
target: 莫哈蘭・普雷蒂斯：小心保管這顆寶石。我請皮特拉・帕特拉用雷射把艾芙莉的肖像刻在上面，讓你一眼就能認出她。也加了條鍊子，比較不容易弄丟。還有……對，很好，我看見你把傳送門位置的通用座標刺在前臂上了。那麼，你帶了指南針、一些冷凍乾燥——

source: Kwalan: There is simply no time to master everything, Mo! Zebna is out there working to end it all. Each day of preparation is a day closer to a potential apocalypse. I will get it done. Please, give me the key.
target: 夸蘭：根本沒時間精通所有事，莫！潔布娜就在外頭，想把這一切終結。每多準備一天，就離可能到來的末日更近一天。我會完成任務。拜託，把鑰匙給我。

source: Kwalan: Mo, remember – for Quent. For humanity.
target: 夸蘭：莫，記住——為了昆特。為了人類。

source: Kwalan: Yes. Of course I’m sure. It has to be done. I have meditated and made peace with the task. I have trained and bulked my body to be swift and painless for the execution. We’ve done the research of the anticipated past environment, people, culture. I’m ready.
target: 夸蘭：是的。我當然確定。這件事非做不可。我已經沉思過，也接受了這項任務。我鍛鍊身體、增強體格，就是為了動手時能迅速、不造成痛苦。我們研究過預期會遇見的過去環境、人物與文化。我準備好了。

source: Moharan Praetis: And language? Have you studied ancient languages of the time?
target: 莫哈蘭・普雷蒂斯：那語言呢？你研究過那個時代的古代語言嗎？

source: Moharan Praetis: ….Yira moved through futures with this gem. What a thing, creating portals to future and past.. Right then. Take it. The chronogate is calibrated to the best of our ability. When you step through, you should arrive within the proper time to kill… right, well, I'll await your return.
target: 莫哈蘭・普雷蒂斯：……伊拉曾帶著這顆寶石，穿行於未來。真不可思議，竟能開啟通往未來與過去的門…… 好吧。拿去。時門已盡我們所能校準。你穿過去後，應該會抵達適合殺死……好，嗯，我會等你回來。

source: This. This moment. On Mt. Vivienne. You’ve watched the family for three days now. Followed them here on their outing. She’s a little girl… Do it and run to the portal. Do not think. Do not think. Girl, woman – it must be done. Shove the child Everly Praetis off of the ledge when they stop for a view. You must. You must. For humanity… THE SHRIEK OF THE MOTHER! RUN! RUN! A CHILD WAILING — EVERLY?! TO THE PORTAL!
target: 就是現在。就是這一刻。薇薇安山上。你已經觀察這家人三天了。跟著他們出遊，一路來到這裡。她只是個小女孩…… 動手，然後跑回傳送門。不要想。不要想。女孩也好，女人也好——都非做不可。 他們停下來看風景時，把小艾芙莉・普雷蒂斯推下崖邊。 你必須。你必須。為了人類…… 母親的尖叫！ 快跑！快跑！ 有孩子在哭——艾芙莉？！ 跑向傳送門！

source: Romina: AYEEEE! Pathfinder! Beloved! You are right! We are NOT kooky-crazy! The people cover their eyes and ears… The dark, the bits… I saw it again but with my two earth-eyes this time! The gate of my third eye is here. The gate I keep… remember what you witnessed, old girl: A strange man, no, no… angel… an ANGEL with cloud clothes, running fierce through the pine… startled me – AH! – up from dozing in the leaves. I watched with my two eyes and the third. Angel stopped suddenly by the abandon grave, panting like a dog. There and then. Then and there I saw the green gem necklace in his hand… he lifted! Lifted it up! He slashed and slashed it about and then, truth. The truth: The rip, the green gem necklace, the dark… The rip of our world. Oh, the beautiful pulse of the gate I keep. He stepped through, back through, to the thrones of angels. Hmm? Yes, we all remember: you are gatekeeper. Mark the spot in the mind. Shut up, shut up for a sec. Look and learn: an old abandoned grave. “Sadie Sloan.” Drag that stump, draaaag it. Place it. The grave and stump. Your GATE, old girl! Yours! Gatekeeper… Oh blessed-happy and perfect day!
target: 蘿蜜娜：呀——！尋路者！親愛的！你說得對！我們沒有瘋瘋癲癲！是那些人摀住了眼睛和耳朵…… 黑暗，碎片…… 我又看見了，這次用的是我這雙塵世的眼睛！第三隻眼裡的門，就在這裡。我守護的門……記住你親眼看見的事，老姑娘： 一個奇怪的男人，不，不……天使……穿著雲朵衣裳的天使，在松林間拚命奔跑……把我——啊！——從落葉堆裡的瞌睡嚇醒了。我用兩隻眼和第三隻眼看著。天使突然停在荒廢的墳墓旁，像狗一樣喘氣。 就在那裡，就在那時。就在那時那地，我看見他手裡的綠寶石項鍊……他舉起來了！高高舉起！ 他揮呀劃呀，然後，真相。真相就是： 裂縫、綠寶石項鍊、黑暗…… 我們世界的裂縫。噢，我守護的門，那美麗的脈動。他跨了進去，回去了，回到天使的寶座。 嗯？是，我們都記得：妳是守門人。把這個地方記在腦子裡。閉嘴，閉嘴一下。看清楚，記起來：一座荒廢的老墳。「莎蒂・斯隆。」把那樹樁拖過來，拖——過來。放好。 墳墓和樹樁。妳的門，老姑娘！妳的！守門人…… 噢，多麼蒙福、快樂又完美的一天！

source: The dimensional calibration must have been wrong. Did I rush things? Pointless to think about now. I’m the prisoner of these stone-age primitives… They are extremely instinctual and alert – athletic and faster than I can ever hope to be. They found me stumbling through the Aspen forest and encircled me before I knew they were all there. I suppose the pines haven’t yet taken this land… I have to escape and go back to Moharan, the Temporal Cathedral. There is no greater mission than this! The tribal leader would not let anyone strike me after he saw me holding the portal key – the green gem. He was utterly moved by it, as if showing some sort of recognition, some sort of longing. He put the necklace around his neck. The other hunters stripped me of my clothes, roped my arms and neck and pulled me back to their village, to my new home – a storage tent for animal skins and various kinds of bones. The moment they released my hands I fell to my knees and began drawing in the dirt, attempting a story they would understand: A figure of a woman (breasts, figure, long hair) giving me the gem. Me, a… wizard-being (hat, staff), holding the gem. I fall (circle-portal) from the sky (clouds) with the gem… The leader crouched, his gaze on the the sky clouds. Then he examined the green gem necklace. He spoke guttural phrases and the hunters tied me to the thick, wooden tent pole. Don't panic. Think. Think Kwalan… think…
target: 維度校準一定出了錯。是我太急了嗎？現在想這些也沒用。我成了這群石器時代原始人的俘虜…… 他們本能敏銳、警覺性極高——身手矯健，速度快得我望塵莫及。他們發現我跌跌撞撞地穿過白楊林，還沒等我察覺周圍全是人，就已經把我包圍。我想，松樹還沒佔據這片土地…… 我必須逃出去，回到莫哈蘭身邊，回到時間大教堂。沒有比這更重要的使命！ 部落首領看見我握著傳送門的鑰匙——綠色寶石——就不准任何人打我。他深受觸動，像是認得它，又像是懷念著什麼。他把項鍊戴在自己頸上。其他獵人剝光我的衣服，用繩子綁住我的手臂與脖子，把我拉回村子，帶進我的新家——一頂堆放獸皮與各種骨頭的帳篷。 他們一鬆開我的手，我立刻跪下，在泥地上畫圖，試著講一個他們能懂的故事：一個女人的形象（乳房、身形、長髮），把寶石交給我。我，一個……巫師般的人物（帽子、法杖），握著寶石。我帶著寶石，從天上（雲朵）掉下來（圓形傳送門）…… 首領蹲下，望著天上的雲。接著，他端詳那條綠寶石項鍊。他喉間說出幾句話，獵人就把我綁在粗大的木製帳篷柱上。 別慌。想辦法。想啊，夸蘭……想啊……

source: The number tortures me… 702 days since I happened in this time. Remember Kwalan: gain their trust, secure the gem, get back to the woods. The universal coordinates are still on your wrist. I beg all and any great creators of existence to deliver me back to my time in Quent when I open the portal. I can act soon, I think… My status has greatly risen since my capture. They even named me. “Breg-nok.” I am Breg-nok. I was first a slave. They bound my legs and forced me to split wood. Everyday my hands bled. One morning, it was too painful to grip the obsidian axe and I panicked. I beckoned over the children and drew their faces on the splitting-log using charcoal, incorporating shadow, depth, light. Soon after, I was asked to make a cave painting of an elk hunt, and the tribe was stunned by the detail – some reached out to touch the art. And so, they released my feet and I became a water-fetcher. I realized then: if I am useful, I gain more freedom. With access to water and groundclay, I showed them pottery – from simple sun-dried bowls to earthen kilns that harden large vessels and clay brick. Bricks led to a sturdy longhouse and the large vessels were used for storing seeds. With access to seeds, I showed them agricultural planning: manuring, seedbeds, simple irrigation. The next harvest was enormous. I took that opportunity to teach them about the constellations, illustrating star patterns as they appeared and how they moved across the year. The Big Bear pattern meant it was time to plant. As I offered to better their lives, I also offered to better their deaths. When an elder died, I introduced the idea of burial tombs as places of cultural remembrance and rest. The tomb, as I drew it, was meant to be a portal into the next life. The leader personally embraced that concept. He had the tribe build a mound-tomb by their local mountain, the one I recognize as Mt. Vivienne. My greatest achievement was instilling a sense of crude empathy, a basic emotional recognition between all members of society. I began with the children, giving them necklaces and showing them through pantomime to clutch it when they wanted to roar in anger, cry in sadness, yell from pain, etc. When they felt hurt, they were to clutch the necklace to show everyone their inner pain. Conflict resolution is still far from perfect, but the children fought so much less that the tribe took up the practice at large. I thank Quent for that – showing me that the greatest fuel for growth is a unified, understanding people. Today, the elders see me as some kind of spirit that fell from the sky. I enjoy full freedom and my Quent-made clothes were returned to me, which I promptly buried in an animal skin at the portal location. I spend my time waiting. Each night, I choose to eat with the leader and his hunters. As he slurps his stew of wild beans and boar meat, I glance at his neck: yes, still there. The gem. I have to be patient. The right moment will emerge. Soon. Soon, I hope.
target: 這個數字折磨著我……從我意外來到這個時代，已經七百零二天了。 記住，夸蘭：取得他們的信任，拿回寶石，回到樹林。通用座標還在你的手腕上。我懇求所有偉大的造物者，讓我開啟傳送門時，能回到屬於我的時代，回到昆特。 我想，很快就能行動了…… 被俘至今，我的地位大幅提升。他們甚至替我取了名字。「布雷格諾克」。我是布雷格諾克。 起初，我是奴隸。他們綁著我的雙腿，逼我劈柴。每天，我的手都在流血。有天早上，手痛得握不住黑曜石斧，我慌了。我招手叫孩子們過來，用木炭在劈柴墩上畫他們的臉，畫出陰影、深度與光線。沒多久，他們請我畫一幅獵捕加拿大馬鹿的洞穴壁畫。部落的人被那些細節驚得目瞪口呆——有人伸手去摸畫面。於是，他們解開我的腳，讓我當取水人。那時我明白：只要我有用，就能得到更多自由。 能接觸水和黏土後，我教他們製陶——從簡單的日曬土碗，到能燒硬大容器與黏土磚的土窯。磚塊成了堅固的長屋，大容器用來儲藏種子。能接觸種子後，我教他們規劃農耕：施糞肥、整苗床、簡易灌溉。 下一次收成極為豐盛。我趁機教他們認識星座，畫出星群出現時的圖樣，以及它們一年之中的移動方式。大熊的圖樣，意味著播種的時候到了。 我提出改善他們的生活，也提出改善他們的死亡。一位長者過世時，我引入墓葬的概念，讓它成為傳承文化記憶與安息的地方。在我的圖畫裡，墳墓是通往來世的門。首領本人很認同這個觀念。他命部落在附近的山旁建一座墳塚——我認得，那就是薇薇安山。 我最大的成就，是灌輸了一種初步的同理心，讓社會中所有成員開始辨認彼此的情緒。我從孩子著手，送他們項鍊，用比手畫腳的方式告訴他們：想憤怒地吼叫、傷心地哭泣、痛得大喊時，就握住項鍊。感到受傷時，就握緊項鍊，讓大家看見內心的痛苦。解決衝突的方式仍遠非完美，但孩子們爭吵少了許多，整個部落便都學了起來。這點，我感謝昆特——它讓我明白，最能推動成長的，是團結而互相理解的人們。 如今，長者們把我當成某種從天而降的靈體。我享有完全的自由，他們也把昆特製的衣服還給我。我立刻用獸皮包好，埋在傳送門所在之處。 我把時間用來等待。每晚，我都選擇和首領及獵人們一起吃飯。他吸溜著野豆燉野豬肉時，我便瞥向他的脖子：對，還在。寶石。 我必須有耐心。適當的時機會出現。 快了。我希望，快了。

source: It’s working. The trap is set. The stones are placed. The leader follows me by himself into the woods. I noticed a few days ago the leader clutching his gem necklace during supper, like anyone does when they want to show hurting, and he whispered a familiar sound – “yee-ra, yee-ra.” The hunters and his family all grunted in acknowledgement. When I repeated the name of my lab colleague “Yira,” he shot his gaze at me. All fell silent. I played dumb to diffuse the tension – shrugged and continued to eat. Guttural chatter resumed. But I realized my opportunity was this strange word. The leader was taken by it. Immediately I began planning, hoping that this word would be the lure I needed… Now is my one, true attempt to leave this past. As he typically does after waking at dawn, the leader relieved himself on the edge of the village. Where I was waiting. I wore a look of concern and I beckoned frantically from the forest saying “Yira, Yira.” He looked around and began to follow me. I kept saying it and beckoning until we reached a stone ring on the ground, below the location of the portal. I had arranged the stones yesterday morning. Confusion, worry began to spread on his face, so I pointed down and emphatically said it more and more – “Yira! Yira!” – and I started scooping cold dirt with my hands, beckoning him to join me. He helped reluctantly but then exclaimed “Yee-ra!” when we began to uncover the animal skin that held my folded, Quent-made clothes. He dug so desperately, so feverishly that he never saw me swing a large stone into his temple. His head bleeds. My throat swells with unexpected shame and guilt. But I go on to take the necklace. I change my dress. Gem in hand, I swipe, and swipe, and slash, and— The portal opens…
target: 奏效了。陷阱已設好。石頭已擺好。首領獨自跟著我走進樹林。 幾天前，我注意到首領吃晚餐時握緊寶石項鍊，就像任何想表達痛苦的人那樣。他低聲唸著一個熟悉的聲音——「伊——拉，伊——拉。」獵人和他的家人都哼聲回應。 我重複實驗室同僚的名字「伊拉」時，他猛地看向我。四周一片寂靜。我裝傻來緩和氣氛——聳聳肩，繼續吃。喉間的交談聲又響了起來。但我意識到，這個奇怪的詞就是機會。首領深受它觸動。我立刻開始計畫，希望這個詞能成為我需要的誘餌…… 現在，就是我真正離開這段過去的唯一機會。 天亮醒來後，首領照例到村子邊緣解手。我就在那裡等著。我裝出焦急的神情，在樹林裡拚命招手，說著「伊拉，伊拉」。他四下張望，接著跟了過來。 我一路呼喚、招手，直到我們來到地上的一圈石頭旁，就在傳送門的位置下方。那圈石頭是我昨天早上擺的。他臉上漸漸浮現疑惑與擔憂，於是我指著地面，愈喊愈急——「伊拉！伊拉！」——並開始徒手挖起冰冷的泥土，招手要他一起。 他勉強幫忙，但當我們挖出包著我摺好的昆特衣服的獸皮時，他喊了一聲「伊——拉！」他挖得那麼急切，那麼瘋狂，完全沒看見我揮起一塊大石，砸向他的太陽穴。 他的頭在流血。突如其來的羞恥與罪惡感哽住我的喉嚨。但我仍取下項鍊，換上衣服。寶石在手，我揮舞，再揮舞，用力劃下，然後—— 傳送門開了……

source: I hope he’s nothing more than a little concussed. His pulse was steady... Oh, Hrokk, forgive me for what I had to do! Pines. Pines! This is good. The Aspen forest is gone. Nearly two years in the stone-age has dulled my memory. I have to find the town of… Asb-Asburn? Should be towards the direction of Quent… I worry this too is not the right time. My hopes are that, somehow, I was supposed to appear in the past before eliminating the Foci Crux, the adult Everly Praetis. Maybe I had to show those primeval people something before I was meant to find Everly as a grown woman with an eyepatch… but I don’t have the luxury to ponder the implications. I must assume Everly was not killed and Zebna is trying to sabotage our future. There – buildings. Homes, businesses, farms… pitched roofs, simple windows… architecturally this looks vaguely correct… but what about all the automobiles? Remember, Kwalan. Do not interfere with anything beyond the mission. Do not jeopardize humanity with a dunderheaded misstep. Watch these townspeople and find her… the face on my gem… Strange – fields of tents. Dozens of horses. Wagons. Marching men in uniform with primitive rifles. Does adult Everly live during a time of war? A time of regression? Bah! I can hardly recall…
target: 希望他只是輕微腦震盪。他的脈搏很穩……噢，赫洛克，原諒我不得不做的事！ 松樹。 松樹！ 這是好事。白楊林不見了。在石器時代待了將近兩年，記憶都模糊了。我得找到那個鎮子……阿斯、阿斯本？應該往昆特的方向走…… 我擔心這次也不是正確的時代。我只希望，不知怎麼地，我本來就應該在消除樞紐焦點、成年的艾芙莉・普雷蒂斯之前，先出現在那段過去。也許，我得先教會那些原始人什麼，才會找到已經長大、戴著眼罩的艾芙莉……但我沒有餘裕思考其中的含義。我必須假定艾芙莉還活著，而潔布娜正試圖破壞我們的未來。 那裡——建築。住家、商店、農場……斜屋頂、簡單的窗戶……建築風格看起來大致對得上……但汽車都到哪裡去了？ 記住，夸蘭。除了任務，不要干涉任何事。別因為愚蠢的失誤，危及人類。 觀察這些鎮民，找到她……寶石上的那張臉…… 奇怪——成片的帳篷。幾十匹馬。馬車。穿制服、拿著原始步槍行軍的人。成年的艾芙莉生活在戰爭時期嗎？一個倒退的年代？呸！我幾乎想不起來了……

source: Bewailing your own failure will do no good. Accept that you failed, Kwalan. Your mission is doomed. Breaths shorter. Fever rises. Lymph nodes swell and throat burns… but nothing hurts more than the pain of my spirit, the pain of my purpose unfulfilled. Despite the crude cauterization, my leg wound’s infection grows worse and I can’t even communicate my needs or remedies. Not that I’d be helped… What irony that I found more kindness and acceptance among Hrokk’s Stone Age people than these supposedly more advanced men. Save for the humanity of one of their leaders called Kw-ail, almost like my name. Those who share my hue of skin treat me with acute animosity and show an eagerness to harm me further. You failed, Kwalan. What now? Will you crumple and invite death to end your misery? End the dream that is Quent? Or will you think… think, Kwalan… do whatever you can... Well, I can bury the green, portal-opening gem in this dirt cell. Or, I can let it live through time in the hands of others... I can give it to the leader, the empathetic one, and then say… what, exactly? What words do I know of this ancient tongue? “You” and “me” and “need” or “go” or “hello” or “must.” Perhaps the last one – if I recall correctly, it can convey purpose. “You must.” Kw-ail will visit again tomorrow morning. Fine then. When he checks on me again... "You must."
target: 哀嘆自己的失敗沒有用。承認失敗吧，夸蘭。你的任務注定完蛋。 呼吸愈來愈短促。燒愈來愈高。淋巴結腫脹，喉嚨灼痛……但沒有什麼比心靈的痛更難受，比使命未竟的痛更難受。 儘管接受了粗糙的燒灼處置，我腿上傷口的感染仍持續惡化，而我甚至無法表達需求或治療方法。就算說得出來，也不見得有人幫…… 真諷刺。赫洛克那些石器時代的人，反而比這些號稱更進步的人更善良、更能接納我。只有其中一位叫「奎——爾」的領袖還有人性，他的名字幾乎和我的一樣。與我膚色相同的人，卻對我懷著強烈敵意，迫不及待想再傷害我。 你失敗了，夸蘭。現在呢？就此崩潰，迎接死亡來終結痛苦嗎？終結昆特這個夢嗎？ 還是想辦法……想啊，夸蘭……盡你所能…… 好吧，我可以把這顆能開啟傳送門的綠寶石，埋在這間泥土地牢裡。或者，我可以讓它在其他人手中，繼續穿越時間……我可以把它交給那位領袖，那個有同理心的人，然後說……到底要說什麼？這種古代語言，我認得哪些詞？「你」、「我」、「需要」，或「去」、「你好」、「必須」。也許是最後一個——如果沒記錯，它能傳達目的。「你必須。」 奎——爾明早會再來。 那就這麼辦。他再來看我的時候…… 「你必須。」
